Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Rule: Automaton rule. life: Conway B3/S23. brain: Brian's Brain (on, dying, off). wireworld: electrons travel along conductors. ltl: Larger than Life using the Sim page ranges. custom: Rulestring.
Rulestring: Birth/Survive rule used when Rule is custom, e.g. B36/S23 or 23/3 (digits are neighbour counts 0-8).
Play: Run the simulation. Off freezes the current cells.
Rate: Simulation steps per second (1-60), relative to a 60 fps timeline.
Stepsperframe: Number of simulation steps computed on each step tick. Higher = faster evolution, more GPU cost.
Reset: Pulse: restart the simulation and re-seed it from in1.
Threshold: Luminance of in1 above which a pixel counts as a seed (0-1). Lower = more of the picture seeds cells.
Invert: Seed from dark parts of in1 instead of bright ones.
Density: Fraction (0-1) of seed pixels that become live cells at Reset. Wireworld: conductors fill the whole mask regardless.
Inject: Per-step probability (0-1) that bright input pixels spawn a new cell while running. 0 = seed only at Reset.
Seed: Random seed for the initial pattern and injection. Change it for a different random layout.
Cellsize: Size of one cell in output pixels. The grid is Resolution / Cellsize, so larger = chunkier and faster.
Coloring: input: cells take the colours of the picture beneath. age: colour by cell age from young to old. flat: single alive colour.
Backdrop: How much of the input shows behind dead cells (0 = black/Dead colour, 1 = full input).
Vivid: Normalises input-coloured cells towards full brightness (0 = as in the image, 1 = saturated and bright).
Cellgap: Gap between neighbouring cells as a fraction of cell size. 0 = cells touch.
Agerange: Age in steps at which a cell reaches the Old colour in age mode.
Ghost: Strength of the fading afterimage left where cells died. 0 = none.
Ghostdecay: How slowly the afterimage fades per step (0-1). Closer to 1 = longer trails.
Colordead: Colour of dead cells in age and flat modes (blended with the input by Backdrop).
Coloralive: Colour of young/alive cells in age and flat modes.
Colorold: Colour of old cells in age mode; also the Wireworld tail and the ghost trail colour in age/flat modes.
Coloraux: Colour of dying cells (Brian's Brain) or conductors (Wireworld) in age and flat modes.
Radius: Larger than Life neighbourhood radius in cells (1-15). Larger = smoother, blobbier patterns and slower.
Ltlbirthlo: Larger than Life: minimum fraction of live neighbours (0-1) for a dead cell to be born.
Ltlbirthhi: Larger than Life: maximum fraction of live neighbours (0-1) for a dead cell to be born.
Ltlsurvlo: Larger than Life: minimum fraction of live neighbours (0-1) for a live cell to survive.
Ltlsurvhi: Larger than Life: maximum fraction of live neighbours (0-1) for a live cell to survive.
